title: Costume Structure 솔로 #018 · super hourglass · 마녀 × 컷아웃 바디콘 (다이아몬드 파임) · stretch velvet · 머리 넘기기 · 전시장 · 코갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, late 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, high ponytail lavender hair — wearing a skin-tight micro witch bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin deep purple stretch velvet with thin shoulder straps and a silver crescent-moon clasp at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just above the diamond, the two sides of the stretch velvet fully covering her bust, a large diamond-shaped cutout down the center of her stomach from under her bust to her lower belly with her navel inside it, the skin inside bare, the stretch velvet remaining at her waist sides and flanks, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole right thigh and the side of her right hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones with small silver stars sewn along it, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the stretch velvet shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin stretch velvet molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the crescent-moon clasp, the small silver stars and the sharp clean edges of the diamond cutout, a soft velvet pile that shifts from deep purple to near black in the folds. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy deep purple leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in deep purple lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.

Background: a vast bright exhibition hall with a smooth pale floor, steel roof trusses, standard-height doors and plain white partition walls, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
